# Artifact index

Select only what earns its upkeep. Combine templates into one packet when fields overlap. These are agent working templates, not repository schema versions or enforced records.

| # | Asset | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Scope card](../assets/01-scope-card.md) | Bound the request and authorized effects |
| 2 | [Revision manifest](../assets/02-revision-manifest.md) | Pin the comparison and execution state |
| 3 | [Evidence ledger](../assets/03-evidence-ledger.md) | Trace each claim to revision-specific evidence |
| 4 | [Findings register](../assets/04-findings-register.md) | Rank demonstrated defects without burying uncertainty |
| 5 | [Coverage map](../assets/05-coverage-map.md) | Show changed-path and interaction coverage |
| 6 | [Verification log](../assets/06-verification-log.md) | Keep execution results and unrun checks honest |
| 7 | [Authority record](../assets/07-authority-record.md) | Separate technical advice, human review, and merge consent |
| 8 | [Staleness report](../assets/08-staleness-report.md) | Invalidate outdated conclusions after drift |
| 9 | [Review decision card](../assets/09-review-decision-card.md) | Present the review disposition without creating authority |
| 10 | [Merge handoff](../assets/10-merge-handoff.md) | Give an authorized operator a bounded merge target |
| 11 | [Learning scar](../assets/11-learning-scar.md) | Retain an observed lesson as a candidate |
